course_name: 商業英文會議與簡報(一)
outline:
本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
This intermediate ESP (English for specific purposes) course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

flexible_learning.content:
Groups design an English dialogue on course themes. Students draft the podcast script themselves (4-5 A4 pages per group; each member’s part must be identifiable), then use an LLM only to refine wording. Submit screenshots of the prompts and AI responses. Upload the audio and script by the deadline.

學生分組設計與課程主題相關的英文對話。學生須自行撰寫講稿 (全組4-5頁A4，每位組員負責段落需可辨識)，初稿完成後才可使用AI工具 (LLM) 調整文字，並繳交校稿截圖 (含提示語與AI回覆)。依期限上傳音檔與講稿，練習英文發音、語調，並學習負責任地運用AI修稿。
flexible_learning.outcome:
第17-18週結束後，學生將能以英文設計並演繹與課程主題相關的Podcast情境對話，運用課堂所學詞彙與句型，並透過錄音練習發音與語調。

By Week 18, students will script and perform an English podcast dialogue on a course topic, applying class vocabulary/sentence patterns and practicing pronunciation through recording.

第17週 (週四12:00前)：繳交節目規劃書。
第18週 (週四12:00前)：繳交音檔與講稿。

Wk17 (due Thu 12:00): planning document.
Wk18 (due Thu 12:00): audio recording + script.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
Wk17–18: 20% of CP.
Week 17-18 作業合計占 課程成績(CP) 20%。

assessment:
* 選修本課程，請務必準時到班上課；第一堂課請勿缺席，若無法到課請事先請假。

(1) Class Performance (CP), including:
- Final Presentation: 30% (15% group score: content, structure, slides, script; 15% individual score: pronunciation, intonation, fluency, eye contact, note reading) [Speaking]
- Mini Presentation: 10% (group + individual score) [Speaking]
- Guided Writing: 15% (2 assignments) [Writing]
- Classroom Activity: 15%
- Project (Weeks 17-18): 10% [Speaking + Writing]
- Attendance: 20% (-5% for each absence)
Speaking is assessed through the Mini Presentation, Final Presentation, and Project (podcast recording) with the Common Speaking Rubric.

* Any student who accumulates FIVE unexcused absences in the semester class will receive a no-credit status. 無故缺席5次，即無法獲得本課程學分。

(2) School-wide English Proficiency Exam (EPE)
----
Overall score = [80% x CP] + [20% x EPE]
